instruction: Activate notification banners on Ubuntu to display desktop alerts.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling notification banners (opposite of original Do Not Disturb task). Config sets show-banners to false initially, user must change it to true. Evaluator checks gsettings value is 'true'. No custom functions needed - uses existing get_vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_command_line executes the appropriate gsettings command to extract notification banner state
Metric logic is correct: exact_match properly compares the command output with expected value 'true\n'
Expected value is correct: 'true\n' matches the actual output format of gsettings command (includes newline)
Coverage is complete: evaluator verifies the single requirement - that notification banners are enabled (show-banners = true)
Data flow is correct: Config sets initial state to false, user enables it, getter extracts the value, metric compares with expected
State accessibility is appropriate: gsettings values are persistent and accessible via command line, no postconfig needed
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' means get_rule returns config['rules'] = {'expected': 'true\n'}, and exact_match correctly accesses rules['expected']
